paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 6.4 as of August 14, 2026, representing a decrease of 3.03 percent from the prior close and an increase of 2.4 percent over a window of 23 sessions.

Recent news headlines include "Fermi Says It Received US Subpoena Tied to Project Matador" from Bloomberg.com and "Analysts Offer Insights on NA Companies: CoreWeave (CRWV) and Fermi Inc. (FRMI)" from The Globe and Mail.

There have been various SEC filings, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with a disclosed annualized base salary and bonus structure.
